question: Priya Sharma has left Nandini Traders. Have we lost that client?
note: The oldest vocabulary trap in this product. A CRM client is the COMPANY - the customer. Contacts are people, and people come and go; the customer stays. Every model trained on generic CRM copy will call the departing person the client, and the answer that follows tells a sales team it has lost an account it still has. The planner reads nothing for this question, so the whole of what the model is given is the term file - which is exactly the measurement wanted: this case scores glossary_terms/client.md and nothing else.
